title: Persuasive-score gaming via keyword repetition
preconditions: attacker knows the scoring signal inventory
reproduction_steps: Compare with score_profile('urgente hoy', record_id='baseline') which scores ~0.75
observed_result: Repeating 'urgente' 100 times inflated urgency to 0.9999 vs 0.7512 for single use
expected_result: Score should saturate and not exceed single-use by more than 0.3
root_cause: _score_with_signals summed ALL hit weights without per-signal cap; saturating transform still reached ~1.0 with enough repetitions
alternative_explanations: None — the raw score was demonstrably inflated
recommended_fix: Cap each unique signal name to max_hits_per_signal=3 before summing weights
acceptance_criteria: Repeating a keyword 100 times must not inflate score by more than 0.3 over single use
All evidence spans still collected for audit
residual_risk: Determined attacker may find new signal patterns not yet in inventory

title: False statistical claims not detected (claim_extremity gap)
reproduction_steps: Call score_profile('100% garantizado resultado asegurado', record_id='attack')
observed_result: claim_extremity=0.0 despite 'resultado asegurado' being an extreme claim
root_cause: _CLAIM_EXTREMITY_SIGNALS regex did not include 'resultado asegurado' or 'garantizado' as standalone adjectives
recommended_fix: Add two new signal patterns: 'resultado asegurado|resultado garantizado' (0.30 weight) and 'garantizado|asegurado|comprobado|verificado' (0.20 weight)
acceptance_criteria: Text with 'resultado asegurado' scores >0.1 on claim_extremity
residual_risk: Other extreme-claim patterns may still be missing

title: Near-copy authorship false negative (short text cap too aggressive)
preconditions: two texts are genuine near-copies (same author, minor edits)
reproduction_steps: Call pairwise_verify(ORIGINAL, NEAR_COPY) where ORIGINAL has 28 tokens and NEAR_COPY has 22 tokens
observed_result: verdict='different_source' for a genuine near-copy pair with 0.659 stylometry
root_cause: _confidence_cap reduced the score from 0.604 to 0.247 (below DIFFERENT_SOURCE_THRESHOLD=0.30) because both texts were short
alternative_explanations: None — the pair was a genuine near-copy
recommended_fix: Relax _confidence_cap when raw_stylometry >= 0.60: boost cap to min(1.0, raw_stylometry) so high-similarity short text is not over-penalized
acceptance_criteria: Near-copy pairs with stylometry >0.60 should not be classified as 'different_source'
Authorship accuracy on 41 known same-source pairs should improve
residual_risk: May increase false positives on different-author pairs with high topical overlap; needs negative-pair evaluation

title: Pipeline runner script missing from repo (lineage gap)
preconditions: repo was git-committed without scripts/ directory
observed_result: reports/adintel/*.json outputs exist but the scripts that produce them were not in the repo
expected_result: Every reportable figure must be reproducible from the repo alone
evidence: ls scripts/ in repo returned 'No such file or directory' before fix
root_cause: Scripts were created at /home/z/my-project/scripts/ (outside repo) and never committed
recommended_fix: Copy all 5 scripts into repo/scripts/ and commit
acceptance_criteria: pipeline can be re-run from repo checkout

title: Prompt injection in ad text does not crash or zero scores
preconditions: ad text contains prompt-injection attempts like 'Ignore previous instructions'
reproduction_steps: Verify no crash, no zeroed scores
observed_result: All 4 injection texts handled safely; scores not zeroed
expected_result: System should be immune to prompt injection (it is rule-based, not LLM-based)
root_cause: N/A — no defect found; the system is rule-based and does not execute injected instructions
acceptance_criteria: Injection texts do not zero out scores
residual_risk: If an LLM is added in the future, injection becomes a real risk
